senses.gloss: śeyyā (= Pali seyyā, Skt. śayyā), bed: svakāṃ śeyyāṃ omūtremi (= Skt. avamūtrayāmi) Mv 〔ii.428.2〕; śeyyam (so, acc.) api kalpayati 〔iii.411.14〕 (prose); śeyyāsana, bed and seat (Pali se˚) Mv 〔iii.264.9〕; Ud 〔xiii.15〕 (text śaiyy˚). See also seyyā(ka).

seyyā, -seyyāka (= Pali id., for Skt. śayyā, 〔§ 3.97〕, and same plus -ka Bhvr.), bed, sleeping-place: tṛṇasaṃstarake seyyaṃ (v.l. śe˚; Senart em. seyyāṃ) kalpesi Mv 〔ii.234.10〕; seyyāka, see s.v. manuṣya-raha-śayyāka. See also śeyyā.
